title: Nice Break From the Bustle of the City
text:
The sailboat tour was a lot of fun. Our call, Violet, was very friendly, spoke very good English and was full of knowledge about Barcelona and what we could see on land from the boat. She was an excellent captain as well. 

We had drinks and some snacks and sat on the sun pads on the deck. 

Overall it was very nice experience and worth the effort and expense.
author: Rodney_L
